name: sd_task_state
meaning: SD client state 0..5; bit7 = request pending (cleared by sender sub_D53A)

name: sd_card_state
meaning: SD card state from reply +0x0C (2/3 = ready, 0 = none); gates all SD menus
evidence: 06FE5E store; tests at 06F5E6, 06FC16, 070BB2..; contradicts doc 74 "picture on-screen"

name: qso_store_kind
meaning: QSO store selector: 0 message, >0 picture, <0 voice

name: sd_scratch_BA4A
meaning: name scratch (photo stem / generated photo name)

name: sd_sum_BA7A
meaning: running additive sum of BACKUP/MEMORY bytes

name: sd_rx_flags_BA92
meaning: SUB frame arrival flags b0 FE(SD reply) b1 EA b2 E4 b3 E6

name: qso_flags_BA93
meaning: b0 status polling, b1/b2 SD job running, b6 QSO list busy

name: sd_req_op
meaning: request op code (+0x10) for generic template

name: sd_req_dir
meaning: directory index (+0x14): 1 BACKUP 2 GPSLOG 3 MEMORY-CH 4 QSOLOG 5 PHOTO 6 VOICE

name: ctx_er1
meaning: saved er1 across async SD step

name: sd_eep_addr_BB04
meaning: current EEPROM address in BACKUP/MEMORY stream

name: qsomng_img_EF00
meaning: QSOMNG.dat image (+0 msg idx, +0x10 pct idx)

name: sd_reply
meaning: SD reply block (FE frame): +0x0C card state, +0x0E status, +0x18 event C8/C9/CD, +0x7E file size, +0x98 payload

name: ipc_req
meaning: outgoing SD request frame (seq, then template header)

name: bt_status
meaning: copy of last E4 Bluetooth code

name: bt_userop
meaning: BT user operation 1 search 2 connect 3 await

name: bt_flags_BB8F
meaning: b1 delete pending, b6, b7 SCO not needed

name: remote_mode_8004
meaning: 0 normal, 1 clone port, 2 remote (node), 3 after reset

name: sd_timer_95DE
meaning: SD step timeout word (12, set by sub_D53A)
